ValidationRule.description: To enforce the field-level values for ...when the Status of a "Compensation Services" Case is changed to "Closed"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Required_Compensation_Services_Closure ) , ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed' ) , ( NSP_Category__c = 'Compensation Services' ) , OR( ISBLANK( Description ) , NOT( ISPICKVAL( Required_Documentation_Attached__c , 'Yes' ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Client_Type__c ) ) , AND( BEGINS( NSP_SubCategory__c , 'Salary Survey') , OR( ISNULL( Data_Lines__c ) , ISNULL( Survey_Jobs__c ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case closure blocked: Required fields missing. All Compensation Service cases: Description, Required Documentation Attached/Yes, Client Type. For Salary Survey sub category: Data Lines, Survey Jobs
